messages:
Hannah Ortiz: Quick follow-up from the retro  two regressions made it past staged rollouts. We should lock owners, short timelines, and an opt-in low-noise probe.
Vikram Rao: I'll take auto-rollback rules. Plan: small rules engine that evaluates error-rate, p95, and user error signatures. It will call an idempotent endpoint `POST /rollouts/{id}/action` with `throttle|pause|rollback`. PoC by Fri.
Nadia Flores: I'll own flag metadata + blast-radius enforcement. Proposal: require `max_blast_radius` on flag create, add server lint + CI gate. Default experimental cap 0.02. PR by Thu.
Eli Turner: I'll handle telemetry & recurring-pattern detection. I'll add a daily canary-anomaly job and a weekly pattern digest, plus backfill 30 days for baselines. Dashboards to #eng-observability.
Hannah Ortiz: Good. Please paste PR links here. I'll add these to the runbook and schedule a 30m weekly sync for 6 weeks.
Vikram Rao: Implementation note: soft trigger should throttle to 0.1% for 15m to gather more signal before pausing. All actions must emit structured audit events.
Nadia Flores: Suggested flag snippet for docs:
```yaml
flag:
  max_blast_radius: 0.02
  initial_fraction: 0.005
  ramp_policy: [0.005, 0.02, 0.1, 1.0]
```
Eli Turner: Saved queries I'll add: `canary_spike` (4x baseline, 10m) and `p95_shift` (>=30% sustained). Alerts to #eng-oncall + owner. Backfill started.
safety-bot: Meeting created: "Rollout safety: follow-ups" weekly Tue 10:00 for 6 occurrences.
Hannah Ortiz: Ownership matrix: Vikram -> rollback (PoC Fri, tests next Tue), Nadia -> flags/schema (PR Thu), Eli -> telemetry (jobs Mon). Rotate primary monthly and name backups.
Vikram Rao: Draft PR for rollback PoC: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/900 (WIP).
Nadia Flores: Draft PR for flag schema + lint: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/412 (WIP).
Eli Turner: Dashboards live in #eng-observability; will ping when alerts are wired.
Hannah Ortiz: Please react :white_check_mark: after you open your first PR. We'll mark items closed in the postmortem once merged. If blockers appear, ping me directly.
Vikram Rao: Agreed.
Nadia Flores: Agreed.
Eli Turner: Agreed.
Hannah Ortiz: Closing note: we agreed to run a deterministic 0.25% long-term probe as a control cohort to reduce false positives; Eli will wire it into telemetry.
